rationale: Separate newly authorized issue; different root cause and nonoverlapping source files from the other new issue, preserving independent acceptance/evidence and ongoing automation reviews.
analysis:
Global viewport modal overlays covered the shell in document, review, lazy-loading and resumed-intake phases; explicit page presentation reuses existing navigation and preserves pending-save and modal safeguards.
Harness-only evidence version: actual native C5 build/frontend tests passed; bundled Playwright qualified in40423083192. The same behavioral regression runs with a self-owned loopback server, sealed default environment and deterministic current evidence paths. All old plans, FAILED journals and four retained source snapshots remain preserved.

Latest genuine-peer correction: A failed save now releases the pending route; a later route asks again, non-navigation close cannot replay a stale destination, finished uploads clear the notice, and the same mobile confirmation is portalled outside the clipped workspace. Real four-width browser cases cover save failure, second route and visible confirmation.

execution.reason: Existing React lifecycle, page geometry, keyboard and draft-save interaction require coordinated senior changes.

separationReason: Independent root causes and no shared changed source files: #506 page surfaces/navigation versus #507 therapy date provenance. Separate worktrees and per-issue PRs avoid coupling.

criteria: Import, review and resumed draft fill the existing main pane without obscuring shell navigation at desktop/tablet/mobile widths.

Independent actual React browser evidence, source integrity, build, frontend tests and privacy checks pass with explicit synthetic localhost fixtures.
